description:
**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Webtoon](https://comic.naver.com/webtoon/list?titleId=799213), [Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8784859)  
Soran, a 23-year-old college student, meets her dream ideal type Kwon Yi-ro after going on a part-time substitute at Christmas. His celebrity-like appearance, kindness, delicacy, and tenderness are perfect! Unfortunately, she split up without asking for his contact information, but she happened to meet Kwon Yi-ro at school where she returned after a long leave of absence. However, where is Kwon Yi-ro, who was sweet as if he would melt all the things when he touched it, and he treats her like a person he doesn't know with his cold eyes..?! A rather noisy campus romance in the middle of youth!
